    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    { "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }
  ]
}';

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId INT NULL,
        companyId INT NULL,
        fullName NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId, companyId, fullName, email, companyName, phone,
        jobTitle, message, leadSource, interestArea, status, assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')), -- companyId is nullable per ADR-001
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Validate privacyConsentAccepted is true (as per PRD hints for public endpoint)
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @payload WHERE privacyConsentAccepted = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Privacy consent must be accepted.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for duplicate normalized email within payload (unlikely for single inserts, but good practice)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email))
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate email entries within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table (using normalizedEmail computed column)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = LOWER(TRIM(p.email))
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            companyId, fullName, email, companyName, phone, jobTitle,
            message, leadSource, interestArea, status, assignedTo, privacyConsentAccepted, created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.companyId,
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'New'), -- Default status to 'New' if not provided
            p.assignedTo,
            p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicate normalized email against existing table, excluding the current record
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = LOWER(TRIM(p.email))
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Another lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            companyId = p.companyId,
            fullName = p.fullName,
            email = p.email,
            companyName = p.companyName,
            phone = p.phone,
            jobTitle = p.jobTitle,
            message = p.message,
            leadSource = p.leadSource,
            interestArea = p.interestArea,
            status = p.status,
            assignedTo = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH;

    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('leadCaptures');
